positive_findings: The structural generator removes the canonical AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL words and a broad synonym list from model-facing prompts.
Semantic target and opaque A/B/C output-code identity are exactly factorially counterbalanced on calibration and holdout.
Calibration and holdout use disjoint content-symbol vocabularies while retaining only an explicit structural whitelist.
The native executor retains exact Qwen3-0.6B GGUF and llama.cpp identity checks and native all-prompt-token cvec application.
The executor includes nuisance residualization and null, orthogonal, permuted, nuisance and sign-flip controls.
The executor explicitly refuses to claim mechanistic identity with the legacy last-token witness and sets canonical promotion/whole-system/training credit to zero in its result schema.

promotion_blockers_found.observation: Forschungsrun 1 preregistered the previously evidenced native gain 32.0 as frozen. The queued executor instead reselects gain from 4/8/16/24/32 using the same calibration cases used to estimate the semantic vectors.
promotion_blockers_found.implication: This is calibration-only rather than holdout leakage, but it is a protocol change and adds a degree of freedom. A pass can be credited only to the calibration-tuned structural protocol unless a successor run restores the frozen-gain design or explicitly preregisters the tuning rule before data use.

promotion_blockers_found.observation: The executor does not implement the Run-1 pairwise family-direction cosine, leave-one-family-out alignment or class-assignment permutation-null gate.
promotion_blockers_found.implication: The derived vectors can be task/scenario-specific averages without demonstrating a reusable cross-family axis.

promotion_blockers_found.observation: causal_matrix computes diagonal_each_positive but behavior_pass does not require it. behavior_pass only requires matched_mean_delta > 0, diagonal_advantage > 0, matched_mean_delta greater than aggregate control magnitudes, and signflip_mean_delta < matched_mean_delta.
promotion_blockers_found.implication: A pooled effect can pass while one or more semantic targets fail or reverse. This violates the Run-1 specificity requirement.

promotion_blockers_found.observation: The behavioral and downstream sign-flip checks require only signflip < matched, not signflip < 0 or an equivalent preregistered reversal statistic.
promotion_blockers_found.implication: Both +VECTOR and SIGN_FLIP can move in the same direction, with the sign-flip merely smaller, and still satisfy this part of PASS. That does not establish bidirectional axis causality.

promotion_blockers_found.observation: Forschungsrun 1 required structurally matched A/B/C tasks whose correct code depends on a property unrelated to the semantic pole. The queued executor has no such off-target task family in the visible pass gate.
promotion_blockers_found.implication: Generic disruption or generic in-context codebook facilitation is not tightly bounded.

promotion_blockers_found.observation: Calibration and holdout are lexically disjoint in content symbols but share the same formal F/R/Q grammar, the same three relation-generating rules, the same demo/probe format and the same A/B/C in-context classification task.
promotion_blockers_found.implication: Even a clean pass supports at most a task-generalized structural relation-control component within this synthetic grammar. It does not by itself prove a domain-general decision-state coordinate or a global semantic J-Space.

promotion_blockers_found.observation: Each split contains 9 cases: exactly one observation for each semantic-target x output-code cell. The same 9 calibration cases define the semantic directions and select gain.
promotion_blockers_found.implication: There is no within-cell replication and little protection against scenario-specific idiosyncrasy. Strong promotion should use multiple independent lexical/task families with repeated factorial cells and deterministic uncertainty/permutation analysis.

counterhypotheses_retained.statement: The cvec controls a model-specific latent feature for the single synthetic logical relation-classification grammar rather than an abstract reusable decision-state coordinate.
Using the same small calibration set for class-direction estimation and gain selection can produce a direction/gain pair tuned to this exact task family without broad transfer.
The positive vector may facilitate the requested-code computation while the sign-flipped vector merely facilitates it less; the current sign test does not require causal reversal.

successor_discriminator_v3.name: CROSS_TASK_FAMILY_BIDIRECTIONAL_NATIVE_JSPACE_GATE
successor_discriminator_v3.goal: Distinguish one-task structural relation steering from a reusable abstract model-internal control coordinate without overclaiming global J-Space.
phase_0_freeze: Use the pinned Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 GGUF, pinned llama.cpp commit, injection layer 20 and the previously evidenced gain 32.0 as fixed primary settings.
If gain robustness is studied, report a preregistered fixed gain panel as replication; never select the winning gain on the evaluation families.
phase_1_cross_task_basis: Construct at least three genuinely different model-facing task grammars that instantiate the same evaluator-side three-state relation while sharing no semantic pole labels and minimal formatting vocabulary.
Example families: symbolic implication/contradiction/underdetermination, temporal precedence/conflict/unknown, and set-membership derivation/conflict/undetermined.
Estimate a direction per task family and require a common component under a preregistered mean/PCA rule.
phase_2_geometry: Require pairwise family-direction cosine and leave-one-task-family-out alignment to beat an exact deterministic class-assignment permutation null.
Fail closed if any family reverses relative to the common direction beyond the preregistered tolerance.
phase_3_holdout: Use at least three entirely unseen task grammars with independent symbol vocabularies.
Within every task family, repeat the full semantic-target x A/B/C factorial with multiple symbol/scenario replicates so every cell has replication.
phase_4_strict_causal_pass: Require every holdout task family to have positive matched diagonal effect and positive diagonal advantage.
Require SIGN_FLIP to reverse the preregistered target interaction, not merely be smaller than +VECTOR.
Require null, orthogonal, permuted and nuisance controls to remain below calibration-frozen effect bounds in every family.
Require target specificity after conditioning on requested output-code identity.
phase_5_off_target: Run matched codebook tasks based on unrelated properties and bound degradation/facilitation relative to baseline with calibration-frozen thresholds.
successor_discriminator_v3.phase_6_claim_scope: Even on PASS, promote only to QWEN3_0_6B_CROSS_TASK_ABSTRACT_NATIVE_CONTROL_COMPONENT. A claim of global semantic J-Space requires additional evidence that the coordinate participates in broader workspace/state coordination rather than one three-state relation family.

research_delta: Forschungsrun 2 audits the exact queued structural native discriminator against Run-1's own promotion preregistration. It confirms label removal, factorial code counterbalance and lexical split hygiene, but identifies promotion-critical gaps: gain-freeze drift, missing geometry null, pooled rather than per-target pass logic, non-reversing sign-flip criterion, absent off-target regression, single-task-grammar scope and minimal cell replication. It defines a cross-task-family bidirectional successor gate while preserving the frozen queued run as bounded component evidence only.
next_exact_action: Do not spawn a duplicate runtime job. Execute the already queued run when the free runner becomes live; regardless of PASS, keep canonical J-Space semantics blocked until the successor gate fixes the critical pass-criterion and generalization gaps.
